methodology.salary_denominator: CBA-defined maximum salary for a player with 10+ years of service, not the highest legacy contract actually paid that season.
methodology.first_pick: Standard No. 1 pick first-year salary at 120% of the rookie scale. First-round picks may sign from 80% to 120%; 120% is the usual benchmark.
methodology.minimum: 0-years-of-service minimum annual salary for a full-season standard NBA contract.
methodology.performance: Basketball-Reference BPM; players are ranked by total minutes and evaluated in fixed top-240/top-300 samples.
methodology.skewness: Adjusted Fisher-Pearson sample skewness. Positive skew means a longer high-BPM tail; it does not by itself mean that more players are above average.
methodology.depth_gap: 95th percentile BPM minus 65th percentile BPM. Lower values indicate a compressed star-to-good-rotation gap; higher values indicate a longer elite tail.
